rows.grounds: adverb indicating an erroneous or false state
potential or conditional expression of becoming
compound denoting the sovereign among yogic practices
compound with intensifier su- expressing extreme difficulty of attainment

items.question: What condition renders the supreme yoga exceedingly difficult to attain?
premises: A conditional situation is introduced by the term 'when'.
The condition involves something proving false or erroneous.
The king of yogas becomes very hard to attain under this condition.
items.inference: If the stated understanding proves false, the supreme yoga becomes exceedingly difficult to attain.
uncertainties: The exact antecedent of 'false' depends on the immediately preceding verses' claim.
items.plain_english: O Goddess, when this proves false, the king of yogas becomes very difficult to attain.
